description: Look up a cannabis or hemp business license by license number or business name on the state lists TerraVault reads (CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, IL, MA, MD, ME, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, VT, WA). Returns the license type, status as the state prints it, city and county, the date the list was read, the state's own record link and the TerraVault page. Never returns phone numbers, emails or owner details.

query.description: A license number (e.g. C10-0000123-LIC) or part of a business name.

name: lookup_license
title: Look up a license
